name: Majordomus Mesh Fabric
basis: historical archive dated 2026-09-11; MUST revalidate HEAD
strategy: sequential, phase-gated, minimize parallel overlapping edits

phases.required_evidence: Evidence: current SHA, paths, exact commands, ownership matrix, collision audit and regression baseline. Reject phase if it merely renames a proposed bus without identifying canonical owner.
Evidence: generated schema and cross-surface contract tests; bad input tests; no duplicate protocol definitions. Gate on backwards compatibility or explicit migration.

Evidence: runnable two-peer demo script and captured real trace, p50/p95 local baseline, tool authorization test, no board polling as messaging. If AI unsolicited ingress unsupported, explicit alternative supported orchestration route with honest capability status.
Evidence: fault matrix with passing repeated runs, restart recovery, stable DB migrations, replay trace, disk/queue limits and no lost accepted durable messages under specified fault model.
Evidence: live provider-backed message/result recorded with runtime versions, correlation, provenance and actual tool invocation; negative receive-capability test; zero hardcoded provider routing.
Evidence: two-host/container-network test, UDP-blocked fallback trace, unauthorized peer denial, cert rollover test and no exposed sensitive metadata in discovery.
Evidence: baseline/after results, route-explain command/endpoint, failure switching tests, telemetry cardinality/privacy budget and fallback rollback test.

Evidence: cross-surface identity consistency suite, generator diff clean, real Cockpit interactions/screenshots if available, docs deploy verification where authorized, governance gate demonstrates deliberate violation detection.
Evidence: clean checkout smoke test, test matrix, threat-model decisions, measured perf budgets, exact release/merge refs, master SHA and demonstrated rollback. No claims of deployed unless verified.
